newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Assembly caucus calls for $1.2 bln tax cut.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Assembly caucus calls for $1.2 bln tax cut.

text.p: California's Republican Assembly Caucus on Wednesday called on the legislature to approve a $1.2 billion tax cut to aid working families in the state.

The 37-member caucus said it supported state Assemblyman Tom McClintock's proposal, which would remove 1.4 million taxpayers from the state tax rolls and provide an average tax reduction of $200 for seven million working-class families.
The Assembly caucus asked the state's budget conference committee to incorporate this proposal into the state's 1997-1998 spending plan.
"We believe that a tax reduction of at least $1.2 billion is a necessary requirement of an acceptable budget plan," the caucus said in a statement.
